title: MSHvSF CPS-2 semantic model
model_kind: Evidence-backed behavioral model; not a decompilation

runtime.route: Two-player Ryu/Ken vs Spider-Man/Captain America; P2 remains neutral

route.control: P1 scripted; P2 human port held neutral

subsystems.proven: The deterministic frontend reaches the same two-player match on cold replay.
subsystems.missing: Mode, round, team, and active-character addresses and writer functions.

subsystems.proven: Exact coin, start, direction, and light-punch edges are recorded with frame and 68000 PC samples.
subsystems.missing: Input-buffer address, command parser, and state-transition call path.

subsystems.proven: Per-frame work RAM and object-list evidence exists for the complete slice.
subsystems.missing: Ryu and Spider-Man actor bases, struct stride, coordinate, velocity, state, animation, collision, and health fields.

subsystems.proven: Idle, walk, and jump visual anchors reproduce with contiguous work RAM, object RAM, palette, and CPS register streams.
subsystems.missing: Movement writers, animation-script pointer, duration fields, assembly decoder, and normalized trajectory.

subsystems.proven: Standing light punch and Hadouken visual sequences, projectile collision, and hit reaction are captured.
subsystems.missing: Attack-state writers, hitbox records, health address, damage value, hitstop, and reaction-state fields.

subsystems.proven: Final framebuffer, CPS object list, palette, and CPS-A/CPS-B register streams are synchronized at every frame.
subsystems.missing: ROM animation/assembly tables and the exact object-command generation path.

subsystems.proven: QSound bus writes and register commits are synchronized to normal and Hadouken windows.
subsystems.missing: Event identifiers, sample ownership, voice allocation, and audible-onset mapping.
